prompts.title: Lola Lago — Vacaciones al sol
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a finished original illustrated front cover for a Spanish-language reading library.
Output: ONE flat, full-bleed vertical cover, 2:3 aspect ratio. The artwork IS the cover, viewed straight on, with no book mockup, spine, tabletop, frame or surrounding background.
Art direction: premium editorial gouache illustration, subtle printed-paper grain, confident painterly shapes, beautifully observed light, refined limited color palette, clear focal silhouette and cinematic depth. A carefully art-directed literary cover, never stock clipart, generic AI fantasy montage, glossy 3D or a crowded collage. Make it compelling both at full size and as a small library thumbnail.
Typography: genuinely excellent book-jacket typography, impeccably spaced high-contrast display serif, generous breathing room and a clear hierarchy. Title in the upper third, integrated with the illustration rather than pasted over busy details. The author credit is smaller near the bottom. Render only the exact requested text, with correct spelling, no invented captions.
Constraints: no publisher logos, franchise wordmarks, badges, CEFR levels, review quotes, ISBN, barcode, watermarks or extra text. All elements within the cover; safe margins around lettering. No plot resolutions or major spoilers.
Scene: the sunlit Costa Brava, a luminous Mediterranean cove below the old stone walls and terracotta roofs of Tossa de Mar. A small restaurant terrace creates an inviting foreground. An observant Spanish woman in her early thirties, short dark pixie haircut, warm olive skin, expressive dark eyes, cream shirt and muted coral jacket, looks out toward the sea in a relaxed three-quarter pose. She is a believable private detective on holiday, not a glamorous spy. A small closed notebook rests beside her on the terrace table. Quiet intrigue beneath a beautiful summer day, no criminals or violence.
Palette and mood: deep Mediterranean teal, ultramarine, warm limestone, terracotta and sunlit cream; sophisticated, airy and warm. Strong elegant shapes, not tourist-postcard kitsch.
Text (verbatim), with these separate lines and hierarchy:
Small series line: "LOLA LAGO"
Very large title: "VACACIONES" / "AL SOL"
Small bottom credit: "LOURDES MIQUEL · NEUS SANS"

prompts.title: Harry Potter y la piedra filosofal
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create one original premium editorial illustration for a library thumbnail, portrait 2:3, full bleed and viewed flat.
Scene: an ordinary quiet English residential street at midnight, red-brick houses with slate roofs, a few warm amber-lit windows and a glowing old-fashioned streetlamp. One pale owl is the main focal point, gliding in a graceful arc beneath a luminous crescent moon. The deep indigo sky has a few delicate stars and soft clouds. Beautiful painterly architectural details, calm cinematic depth, an atmosphere of quiet wonder.
Style: refined hand-painted gouache with subtle printed-paper texture, confident shapes and sophisticated limited color. Deep midnight indigo, dark bottle green, parchment highlights and honey-gold window light. A beautifully composed literary illustration for adults and younger readers alike.
Composition: the owl and moon form a strong readable silhouette in the upper middle, the street recedes toward a distant warm light, the lower foreground provides a dark frame. Visually rich but not cluttered.
This image is an illustration only. No text, letters, words, titles, signatures, logos, people, human figures, named characters, school emblems or mockup objects. No violence or frightening imagery.
